result.process_summary: Both the nightclub bouncer and the firewall act as gatekeepers that inspect incoming entities against a set of predefined rules, allowing authorized entries while denying or redirecting unauthorized ones, thereby establishing a protective boundary between a trusted interior and an untrusted exterior.
potential_breaks: The bouncer relies on human judgment and can make subjective decisions, whereas a firewall follows deterministic, programmed rules.
Physical enforcement (e.g., using force) by a bouncer has no direct analogue in digital packet filtering.
A bouncer typically handles a single entry point, while a firewall can filter traffic across multiple network interfaces and ports simultaneously.
